name: Follow a route map
short_description: Follow a marked route with at least five decision points and confirm arrival at the intended destination.
self_assessment: I can follow a five-decision route map without help and confirm my destination.
description: Follow a marked route with at least five decision points and confirm arrival at the intended destination. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Follow a route through a public venue
